definition.universe: perp_pit_xs_v1 cohort, binance_um, 10 USDT-M perps (ADA/BNB/BTC/DOGE/DOT/ETH/LINK/LTC/SOL/XRP USDT-PERP), daily decision bars, 2023-01-01..2026-08-30; extendable: the cohort builder supports adding symbols, but the 2-vs-2 edge and >=8-asset day gate were measured on ~10 assets (~4-5 effective XS dof/day) — a larger universe changes the edge geometry and must be re-measured

entry_condition.rank_score: dfh20 = close / max(close, 20 strictly-prior daily bars) - 1; the RAW value is ranked cross-sectionally per decision day — the trailing-180 mid-rank pct transform used by the time-series dfh cells is NOT applied to the XS rank
entry_condition.rank_rule: each decision day with >=8 scored assets (score AND forward return present): sort by raw dfh20; long top-2 (highest = nearest its own 20d high, momentum/continuation direction), short bottom-2 (lowest = furthest below its 20d high)
entry_condition.weights: equal weight; each leg 1/4 of book; dollar-neutral; gross leverage 1.0
entry_condition.mandatory_regime_gate: ACTIVE only when BTCUSDT close / close[t-20] - 1 > 0 (strictly-prior 20 daily bars, same close basis as the cohort); FLAT otherwise. Non-optional: measured uptrend days +111.4bps (t=4.54, n=708) vs downtrend days -13.8bps (t=-0.69, n=605) — ungated the signal does not survive

exit_condition.time_stop: daily rebalance — membership is re-ranked every decision day; no fixed holding period; ~27% of leg slots turn over per day (measured 0.269)
exit_condition.regime_off: flat when the BTC 20d trend gate reads <= 0
exit_condition.reporting_horizon: 5d forward close return is the headline evaluation horizon (1d/3d/10d also positive: +14.8/+32.4/+111.3bps per horizon)

not_a_component: trailing-180 mid-rank pct of dfh20 (time-series convention; the XS rank uses the raw value)
XS funding_pct rank (T104/T108: +5.3bps/day, t=0.33 — null, as the post-2020 carry literature predicts)
mom20 XS rank as primary score (T108: +44.8bps but 3/4 folds — weaker than dfh20)
freshness/decay timing — lag-3 ranks earn as much as fresh (63.5 vs 53.7bps): the score is a slow characteristic, no fast-refresh requirement
literal quintile-of-book portfolio — on ~10 assets quintile degenerates to a 1-2 asset edge; adaptive-depth check only

robustness_t106.rank_depths: top1 +71.0 / top2 +53.7 / top3 +43.5 bps, all 4/4 folds

bybit_replication_t107.note: 5-asset Bybit cohort; top2-vs-bot2 uses 80% of that cross-section

benchmark_t108.cross_scale: replicated_both_scales — daily dfh20_pct rho +0.028 PASS plus XS rank PASS

close_vs_mark_basis.note: close is the mark proxy for all 10 symbols; the Bybit mark-series robustness cell (rho +0.0256) confirms the dfh effect is not a close-basis artifact

residual_risks.thin_cross_section: ~4-5 effective XS dof/day on a 2-vs-2 edge over ~10 assets; one asset's jump swings a daily spread
residual_risks.overlapping_labels: 5d labels on daily bars overlap ~80%; all t-stats are nominal (iid assumption) and overstate effective n
residual_risks.close_price_basis: klines close used as mark proxy for all 10 symbols; |mark/close-1| measured <= 26.3bps max on the 5 legacy symbols; the 5 expanded symbols have no mark archives in the bounded slice (unmeasured)
residual_risks.score_identity_confound: lag-3 staleness test loses nothing (63.5 vs 53.7bps) — dfh20-rank may partly proxy persistent asset identity rather than a per-day signal
residual_risks.lookback_selection: dfh20 was literature-suggested, not found by a lookback search on this data; dfh10 (+22bps, 3/4 folds) and dfh60 (+53bps, 3/4) neighbours soften but do not cure selection risk
residual_risks.regime_gate_single_point_of_failure: the entire edge sits behind one estimated quantity — the BTC 20d trend; estimation error or regime misclassification gates the whole book
residual_risks.period_effects_inside_gate: pooled yearly folds are all-positive but fold-level period effects may persist inside the gated subpopulation (gated per-year cells not separately verified)
residual_risks.net_sim_simplifications: no funding cashflows, no borrow cost on shorts, fills at decision close, linear 5bps cost, no market-impact model

forbidden_interpretations: not a profitability or live-trading claim
not authorization to train RLCD or trade
not evidence the signal persists beyond the measured window

relationship_to_spec_v1.portfolio_role: orthogonal sleeve: a dollar-neutral long-short XS book vs spec v1's long-only conditional entries — no shared positions by construction
relationship_to_spec_v1.shared_master_gate: both sleeves are conditioned by the SAME market-wide gate — BTC 20d trend > 0 (spec v1: mark_price 20-bar log return on perp_pit_v1; this spec: close/close[t-20]-1 on perp_pit_xs_v1 — identical construction, close basis). Track-B structural finding (T79/T99/T106/T107): one market-level state variable gates every daily-frequency signal
relationship_to_spec_v1.signal_family: same underlying dfh20 feature as the T101 time-series cell and spec v1's descriptive overlay, but a different contrast geometry — cross-sectional rank here vs within-asset trailing percentile there (T108 cross_scale: replicated_both_scales)

next_gate: OOS forward evidence on post-freeze decision days (same path as spec v1) is required before any freeze-for-use; status remains spec_candidate_pending_review — NOT frozen for trading. RLCD use (XS rank state feature / book-level policy) requires a new protocol + owner authorization
